q1_issues.issue: "till next week" is attached as (Time sk_put_off_1 next_week), asserting that the putting-off itself happened next week — which contradicts the (Past sk_put_off_1) on the same event; "till/until Y" is the interval End form, and here it names the game's new schedule, not the time of the postponing.

q2_gaps: the "till/until T" complement of a rescheduling verb ("put off / postponed till next week"), where T is the new time of the postponed occurrence — the Intervals section reads "until Y" only as an End bound on the eventuality's own extent, and nothing licenses moving the time onto the Patient occurrence
notes: Everything else is right: the phrasal verb is kept whole as put_off with no genus, the agentless passive omits the Agent, the scheduled-occurrence object is correctly Patient, and next_week stays a bare deictic constant.
